name: label
title: Label
description: A field's label: DM Sans Medium in capitals with 6% tracking, in the soft gray, over the control it names. A muted hint can follow it.
use_for: Naming a field or a control when Field's layout does not fit: a label beside a switch, over a slider, over a group of radios.
never: A placeholder in place of a label
Bold, color or a spectrum accent on a label
Sentence case or long text in a label: say it in two or three words, and put the rest in a hint under the field
source: Derived from the brand guidelines: labels in DM Sans Medium, capitals, 6% letter spacing (type page), the neutral steps for the gray
